rule.name: ImmutableCollectionChanged
rule.message: This collection comes from a fixed-size or immutable factory (Arrays.asList, List.of, Set.of, Map.of, Collections.empty*, singleton*, unmodifiable*, Stream.toList(), ImmutableList and the like) and is never replaced by a mutable one, so changing it throws UnsupportedOperationException, often only on the path that starts from the default value. Build a mutable copy where the code changes it (`private final List<String> comments = new ArrayList<>(List.of("#"));`), or keep the factory and stop changing it. An exception fits only for a call that is meant to fail.
